leadText: Rinko Natsuhi (Japanese: 夏日凜子 Natsuhi Rinko) is a Japanese voice actress for .
plainText:
Rinko Natsuhi (Japanese: 夏日凜子 Natsuhi Rinko) is a Japanese voice actress for .

==Biography==
Natsuhi was born on October 21, 1986, and became a voice actress as an adult. She was affiliated with and mostly got minor roles in anime series. Natsuhi became involved with the during , voicing her best-known role to date, Team Flare scientist Aliana.

==Pokémon roles==
===Animation===
==== ====
Aliana
Boy (XY124)

==Other non-Pokémon roles==
Child ( (ep. 6))
Mother, Passerby B ( (eps. 9, 13))
Citizen ( (ep. 4))

==Trivia==
Natsuhi is involved with the same talent agency as Mariya Ise, the voice actor of and other characters.
